name: Wikipedia and Wikidata
description: Open two public pages in a fixed tab order, then return to the original article.
intro: Welcome. We will follow the same subject across two public sites and revisit a tab we already opened.

steps.title: Open Work in the Wikipedia article
steps.say: I use the article's table of contents to open Work in the first tab.

steps.title: Open the Wikidata entry
steps.say: The second tab opens the structured data entry for the same subject.

steps.title: Return to the original article
steps.say: I select Biography in the first tab. Both tabs remain open in their original order.
